testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect actions for a recent document card ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent documents are displayed in Grid View ✔ And no recent-document cards are checked ✔ When the user hovers over a recent part card ✔ And the user opens its actions menu ✔ Then the menu offers Open and opens with options ✔ And the menu offers Remove from Recent ✔ And the menu offers commands to open or explore the containing folder ✔ And the menu offers document properties ✔ When the user clicks outside the menu ✔ Then the actions menu closes
